{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 values in customer_age
age_neg1_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'Number of -1 values in customer_age: {age_neg1_count}')

# Check revenue column
print('\nFirst 5 values of revenue (as string):')
print(df['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for thousands separators
revenue_sample = df['revenue'].head(10)
has_commas = revenue_sample.str.contains(',', regex=False).any()
print(f'\nDoes revenue contain commas? {has_commas}')"}
